---
title: "U46619_Depolarisation_Amplitude_Groups"
author: "Mirja grote Lambers"
date: "2026-03-20"
output: html_document
---
  
This script is used to determine whether statistically significant differences in depolarisation amplitude occur following the application of U46619 across three experimental groups (intracellular solutions containing 34, 8 and 34 mM Cl⁻ followed by the addition of 10 µM Ani9). Descriptive statistics (mean ± SEM, median, standard deviation, n) and tests for normality (Shapiro-Wilk test, histogram, QQ plot) are reported for each group. A Tukey-type contrast test (nparcomp::mctp) is used to test for all pairwise differences.

H0: The depolarisation amplitude does not differ systematically between any pair of groups (relative effect p = 0.5 for all pairwise contrasts).

H1: At least one group differs systematically from another (relative effect p ≠ 0.5 for at least one pairwise contrast).


library(nparcomp)

# load data
df <- read.csv("U46619_Depolarisation_Amplitude_Groups.csv")
 
group_levels <- c("34 mM Cl-", "8 mM Cl-", "10 µM Ani9")
 
df <- data.frame(
  value = df$U46619_depolarisation_amplitude_mv,
  group = factor(df$intracellular_solution, levels = group_levels)
)
df <- df[!is.na(df$value) & !is.na(df$group), ]


# descriptive statistics
invisible(Map(function(grp) {
  x      <- df$value[df$group == grp]
  n      <- length(x)
  sd_val <- sd(x)
  sem    <- sd_val / sqrt(n)
  ci     <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sem
  sw     <- shapiro.test(x)
 
  cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", grp))
  cat(sprintf("  n              = %d\n",                  n))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean ± SEM     = %.2f ± %.2f mV\n",     mean(x), sem))
  cat(sprintf("  95%% CI (mean)  : [%.2f, %.2f] mV\n",   mean(x) - ci, mean(x) + ci))
  cat(sprintf("  Median         = %.2f mV\n",             median(x)))
  cat(sprintf("  SD             = %.2f mV\n",             sd_val))
  cat(sprintf("  Shapiro-Wilk   : W = %.3f, p = %.3f\n", sw$statistic, sw$p.value))
 
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  hist(x, freq = FALSE, col = "steelblue", border = "white",
       main = paste(grp, "— Histogram"), xlab = "Depolarisation (mV)", ylab = "Density")
  qqnorm(x, main = paste(grp, "— QQ-Plot"))
  qqline(x, col = "red")
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
 
}, group_levels))


# tukey-type multi comparison test
set.seed(42)
results <- mctp(value ~ group, data = df,
                type        = "Tukey",
                alternative = "two.sided",
                info        = FALSE,
                plot.simci  = TRUE)
 
summary(results)
